summary: Verified deployment probe fix and full regression. (1) GET /health on localhost:8001 returns 200 {"status":"ok"} and performs NO DB call (inspected container_health() — just returns dict). (2) Externally the /health path is served by frontend ingress (React SPA HTML) with 200, which is fine because the failing Kubernetes probe was internal (127.0.0.1 → :8001) and that now returns the JSON body. (3) GET /api/health returns {"status":"ok","database":"connected"} and, per code, falls back to {"database":"unreachable"} on ping failure instead of raising. (4) Startup hook wraps ensure_indexes()+seed_admin() in try/except; supervisor log shows 'Indexes ensured; admin seed: unchanged' with no tracebacks across 3 recent restarts. (5) auth._secret() returns HTTPException 503 when JWT_SECRET missing (code inspected) — with JWT_SECRET present, login/me/refresh/admin all work as verified by full regression. (6) Full regression PASSED: test_step1_backend.py + test_admin_backend.py = 46/46 in one xdist run; test_lockout_regression.py = 6/6 in a separate serial run. Total 52/52. (7) Public site end-to-end via ingress: homepage loads with hero-search-input, /resources renders 6 resources, /universities and /courses pages present. (8) Admin panel end-to-end: admin login → overview counts visible → categories create/edit/archive round-trip successful → logout redirects to /admin/login. No pageerrors; console 401s are pre-login /api/auth/me probes (expected). DB left pristine: 6 active categories after cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: Externally, GET /health at the ingress hits the React app (returns index.html with 200), not the FastAPI /health. That is acceptable because the failing K8s probe is a container-local 127.0.0.1:8001 probe and the new @app.get('/health') answers it correctly — but if any external monitor is pointed at ${DOMAIN}/health it will see HTML instead of the JSON status. Document/route accordingly if that matters.
Deferred from prior iterations (still valid): CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True while CORS_ORIGINS='*' — replace with an explicit allowlist before production.
seed_admin still silently rotates the admin password on every restart when ADMIN_PASSWORD differs; adding an explicit 'admin password rotated from env' log line would make it observable in prod.
auth.set_auth_cookies hard-codes samesite='none'+secure=True; will break http localhost dev — gate on APP_ENV.
The unprefixed /health handler is a great addition; consider also adding an unprefixed /ready (readiness) that DOES verify DB connectivity so readiness can gate traffic while liveness stays DB-free.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_CAT_ITER4 category during admin panel round-trip. Final counts verified: 6 active categories. No residual TEST_ records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment probe fix is complete and verified. /health (unprefixed) → 200 no-DB; /api/health → 200 with DB status field that tolerates ping failure. Full regression harness = 52 tests. Note that pytest.ini has xdist addopts, so test_lockout_regression.py must be run with `-o addopts=''` when invoked separately to avoid concurrent admin-account contention with test_admin_backend.py.
